items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I am a Hawaiian Grammy winning producer. I produced a record for a young girl named Brittni Paiva who

ctx.x: What’s on your docket these days?

Well right now of course I’m doing some gratis work. Of course I’ve got my podcast, I’ve got a radio show on KJZZ which is the Southern California jazz station, I’ve got a weekly jazz show there called “Hang Time with Tom Scott.” I’m doing of course I’ve done a lot of — I got on Tik Tok at the recommendation of the guy who is now my producer in Connecticut actually, and so I’ve got a whole series of Tik Toks where they’re sort of two part Tik Toks. The first one is where I play that portion of a record where I’ve…

is a wonderful ukulele player in Hawaii and we did a whole album with her, some jazz tunes, some folky, folkish kind of tunes, even one classical tune. We did the Faure “Pavane” kind of in the style of a Bill Evans with a symphony orchestra record. And except for her playing and a couple of jazz soloists that I got on the record, Arturo Sandoval, Ray Parker and Michael McDonald did a whole bunch of vocals on one of his tunes. But the rest was all me: drums and bass and keyboards and strings and everything, and…
